text:
Maya (CS): Quick sync for OpalCrest private deploy week0. Roadblock list from their infra: egress IPs unknown, transit attachment pending, and they asked for explicit KMS alias naming + rotation window. Also flagged renewal as medium-risk if baseline cutover slips past Apr 10.

Tom (Network): We're holding a pool of 4 static NAT EIPs for customer use. I'll allocate and paste them in this thread by EOD. Need exact firewall ports they expect outbound (TCP/UDP).

Maya (CS): They responded: outbound to 3rd-party telemetry on ports 443 and 9000; management plane access on 22 restricted to our jump host.

Priya (SE): For KMS: what's the desired rotation cadence? We recommend 90 days for customer-managed keys here, but if they want vendor rotation we can offer 365-day rollover. Also proposing alias convention: alias/redwood/cust-<shortid>-<region>.

Arjun (SRE): Audit/logs: OpalCrest prefers direct push to their Splunk HEC over mTLS. They provided endpoint https://hec.opalcrest-inc.com:8088 and token placeholder. Question: do they need raw JSON or our normalized event schema? If normalized, we'll add mapping in our collector.

Sam (PM): Renewal watch: I logged a reminder in Salesforce. If we miss Apr 10 cutover, Sales wants an executive check-in before Apr 17.

Priya (SE): Example KMS alias + policy snippet (adjust ARNs):

```
# recommended alias format for customers
resource "aws_kms_alias" "opalcrest_alias" {
  name          = "alias/redwood/cust-opalcrest-usw2"
  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.opalcrest.id
}

resource "aws_kms_key" "opalcrest" {
  description       = "OpalCrest customer-managed CMK (private deploy)"
  deletion_window_in_days = 30
  enable_key_rotation = true
}
```

Tom (Network): EIPs assigned: 34.201.12.45, 34.201.12.46, 34.201.12.47, 34.201.12.48. Posting route table patch next.

Arjun (SRE): Thanks Tom. BGP/Transit details: we need their ASN + peering CIDRs. Maya, can you confirm? Also for Splunk: if they only support token-based HEC (no cert), we can ship over TLS to their endpoint using our certs; mutual TLS optional.

Maya (CS): Confirmed from OpalCrest: ASN 64522, peering CIDR 172.16.100.0/24. They cannot provide a client cert for mTLS today. Token provided via secure ticket with ID #1423.

Arjun (SRE): OK we'll configure collector to use TLS + HEC token. Priya, please add a mapping step to convert our internal event keys to their expected fields (source, service, level).

Priya (SE): Will do. Also adding a note to the runbook about alias naming and rotation cadence. Link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/opalcrest-private-cutover

onboard-bot: Checklist updated: "EIPs allocated" checked; "Transit peering" pending; "HEC token received" checked. Checklist: https://redwood.example.com/checklists/opalcrest

Maya (CS): Action items recapped: 1) @Tom apply route table + provide firewall port snippet to OpalCrest; 2) @Arjun configure HEC shipper with token + schema mapping; 3) @Priya add KMS alias + rotation notes to runbook; 4) @Sam monitor renewal timeline and escalate if cutover slips. Meeting tomorrow 9am PT to review. :calendar:

Tom (Network): Will update route patch before EOD and ping ops once done.

Sam (PM): I'll update the risk status post-meeting and paste any Sales outreach notes into this thread.

Maya (CS): Thanks all 44d we'll reconvene after the 9am. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.

Arjun (SRE): One more note: I'll enable verbose audit log level for first 48hrs after cutover so auditors have extra context. Will toggle off after 48hrs.

Priya (SE): PR ready for runbook changes, linking in the meeting agenda.

Maya (CS): Closing for now 50e
